name: Hiroshi Okabe
source:
Hiroshi was born in Osaka to one half of a famous Manzai act, and has since carried the pressure of following in their footsteps with his older brother. Rarely certain of himself, Hiroshi seems to get more laughs from his sheepish clumsiness than any jokes he tells. The burden of continuing their legacy was only amplified when his father and brother were killed in an accident, and now Hiroshi is left to move forward on his own, trying his hardest to make himself and others smile.
